config.reestimation_rule: frozen at T0 for all 6 models (declared, duel_origins.py) -- no residual asymmetry: every adapter is fit exactly once on data <= T0, only conditioning state advances at later origins.
config.sampling: genuine model-native trajectory sampling (duel_sampling_adapters.py) for all 5 classics, never a Gaussian/log-normal reconstruction of stored CI bounds (audit reserve N1).
config.scoring: crps_fair (Ferro 2014), m identical across all 6 models.
config.verdict_reading_rule: read as Model Confidence Set membership per (asset, horizon), never as "jeu egal"/"globalement moins bon" (audit reserve N3).
